title: KinoClient
description: A browser-to-server message of the Kino feed, version 1 (decision 0075, amended 2026-11-11). Exactly two messages exist: subscribe and unsubscribe. PRINCIPLE 1: they carry no world input: no command, chat, coordinates, block, entity or input event. The server checks the target against the login scope on every subscribe (decision 0075 point 4). Identity comes from the connection, never from a message.

SubscribeMessage.description: Ask to watch one agent, in a camera mode.

UnsubscribeMessage.description: Stop watching. No fields beyond type.
